attempts.text:
The only designated evacuation point is Myagang shelter. Uttargaya school is not one, so people dropped there would not count as rescued.

- **Children at Uttargaya school:** A round trip from Myagang costs 56 minutes (28 each way). Deferring the two children would cost 120, so rescuing them is cheaper.
- **Group at Syaphru temple (one adult, two elderly):** Reaching them means 28 + 8 + 31 = 67 minutes each way, so a round trip costs 134. Deferring them costs 20 + 50 + 50 = 120, which is cheaper.
- **Combining the trips:** Taking everyone in one run would put five people in a four-seat car. Rescuing everyone costs 190 whether the children are ferried first or one child is picked up on the way back. Both are worse than 56 + 120 = 176.

<plan>
drive car1 myagang-shelter uttargaya-school
load car1 child 2
drive car1 uttargaya-school myagang-shelter
unload car1 child 2
defer syaphru-temple adult 1
defer syaphru-temple elderly 2
</plan>

COST: 176
